problem.title: Shortest Subarray with Sum at Least K
problem.problemStatement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, find the length of the shortest non-empty contiguous subarray whose sum is at least k. If no such subarray exists, return -1.
problem.input: Integer n Array nums Integer k
problem.output: A single integer representing the minimum subarray length, or -1 if no valid subarray exists.
